name: io.github.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents
title: Astro Agents - deterministic Western + Vedic astrology
description: Natal charts, transits, kundli, dashas, panchang, Gun Milan. JPL DE440, no LLM, hashed.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.positioning: Deterministic Western + Vedic astrology API for AI agents: JPL DE440 ephemeris, no LLM, reproducible SHA-256 hashes.

tools.resolve_birth_time: Local birth time + place -> exact UT, historical UTC offset, Delta T, Local Mean Time, true solar time. ($0.01 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.planet_positions: Tropical (or sidereal) longitudes, latitudes, speeds and retrograde flags of Sun..Pluto, nodes, Lilith. ($0.01 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.aspects: Aspects (with orb, exactness, applying/separating) for a moment, or for any longitudes you supply. ($0.02 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.natal_chart: Complete natal chart: planets in signs and houses, ascendant, MC, 11 house systems, aspects, summary. ($0.06 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.transits: Transits to a natal chart at a moment, and exact hit times over a window of up to a year. ($0.08 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.synastry: Relationship comparison: cross-aspects, house overlays both ways, composite midpoints. ($0.12 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.nakshatras: Sidereal nakshatra, pada and lord of every graha; janma nakshatra with gana, yoni, nadi, varna. ($0.02 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.panchang: Tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga, karana with the exact time each ends, plus sunrise and sunset. ($0.02 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.kundli: Sidereal D1 + D9: lagna, 9 grahas with rashi, nakshatra, pada, house, dignity, combustion, bhavas. ($0.15 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.kundli_full: The kundli plus all Shodashavarga divisional charts D1..D60 (Parashara rules). ($0.32 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.vimshottari_dasha: Vimshottari maha/antar/pratyantar periods with exact dates, birth balance, and the running periods. ($0.10 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.doshas: Manglik (Kuja), Kaal Sarp and Sade Sati / Dhaiya, each with the exact rule applied and dates. ($0.15 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.gun_milan: 36-point Ashtakoota marriage compatibility: all 8 kootas with reasons, doshas and Manglik check. ($0.25 over REST; first 3 calls free)
tools.vedic_report: Kundli + Vimshottari dashas + doshas + janma panchang in one call. ($0.50 over REST; first 3 calls free)

trust: Positions from NASA/JPL DE440 (NASA/JPL), 1800-01-01..2200-01-01, via Skyfield: geocentric apparent, true equinox of date, IAU 2006/2000A.
Historical time zones resolved for you (IANA tz database, DST of the era, Local Mean Time); ambiguous or non-existent local times are flagged, never guessed.
Deterministic, no LLM: same input -> same bytes. Every response carries meta.input_sha256 and meta.result_sha256 (also as X-Input-SHA256 / X-Result-SHA256 headers); POST /v1/verify recomputes one.
Every convention is in the response: ayanamsa (name, true and mean value), house system, orbs, node type, dasha year length, dosha and koota rule sets.
Cross-validated against an independent engine (XALEN, Apache-2.0): ayanamsas agree to < 0.1", 15/16 divisional charts identically, all 11 house systems in structure.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: Pay per call with **x402** (USDC on Base or Solana) or **MPP** (Tempo). No account, no API key. First 3 calls free per caller (x402 Sign-In-With-X).
